Fast Track Court to Hear Bail Pleas in NEET UG Paper Leak Case

A fast-track court in Delhi is scheduled to hear the bail applications of Dinesh and Vikas Biwal in connection with the NEET UG paper leak case. The court, located at Rouse Avenue, will begin its proceedings with these bail pleas. The accused, Dinesh and Vikas Biwal, had submitted their petitions seeking release.
